messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High error budget burn detected on inference-gateway (us-east-1). 5xx spike at 1794604321. Alert routed to on-call.
jem-noc: oncall acked — initial stack traces show redis timeouts + rapidly increasing eviction counts on cache-primary.
liam-oc: I'm on it. taking live look at pods + metrics. scaling gateway to buy time: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway --replicas=10`
ana-sre: joining shortly, watch for config commits around the timeframe.
deploy-bot: CI/CD: recent config commit cfg-2026-02-15-cache-ttl by tariq-eng at 1794604200
liam-oc: reverting that commit now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway --to-revision=23` — will monitor 5xx and queue length
tariq-eng: I submitted TTL trim to reduce memory. surprised — I'll pause all TTL changes and follow up.
sasha-pm: flagging customer impact — support has inbound tickets from: nebula-ai, papaya-ads, acme-corp. Nina, can you start fast-triage pulls and capture customer request-ids?
nina-support: on it. exporting request ids and counts now. will add to shared doc.
liam-oc: rollback complete. 5xx rate from 7.8% -> 1.0% over 6m. queue depth trending down.
nana-sre: hypothesis: aggressive TTL clamp caused premature evictions, KV cache churn, routing latencies -> client timeouts. collecting flamegraphs and eviction histograms for postmortem.
sasha-pm: scheduling: let's lock postmortem for 1794680721 (48 hours) 15:00 UTC. attendees: SRE, Eng-Platform, Product, Support, Finance. please accept.
rebecca-finance: joining. need to determine SLA credit exposure. To calculate, I need: list of affected customers, start/end impact window, count of failed requests per customer, and their SLA terms (credit percentage / thresholds). Also invoice numbers for the current billing period.
jem-noc: preliminary impact window: 1794604200 -> 1794604600 (6 minutes) but some retries extended downstream; we should consider 1794604180 -> 1794604780 for conservative calc.
sasha-pm: rough affected customers + counts (prelim): nebula-ai 1,250 failed requests; papaya-ads 420; acme-corp 3,100. attaching CSV to incident doc. link: https://redwood.example.com/incident/1794604321
rebecca-finance: thanks. quick note on process: finance will open internal adjustments ticket FIN-6427 once postmortem published. If provisional credits > $5k we need manager sign-off; > $25k needs VP approval. I'll triage thresholds after I compute numbers.
liam-oc: ops action items: 1) add a short-circuit guard to config-service to block TTLs below 30s (liam-oc) 2) add automated canary for cache-affecting commits (ana-sre + eng-platform) 3) increase retention of request traces tied to 5xx (nina-support).
tariq-eng: accepting owner for TTL guard and unit tests. PR in progress. ETA 5 days.
nana-sre: monitoring action: add alert `cache-eviction-surge` (fires if eviction rate >80% baseline for 5m) and `config-change-canary-fail` (if new config correlates with error delta>2%).
sasha-pm: customer comms plan: draft message + optional call offer. Nina, will you help assemble affected customers and preferred contacts? Support to send initial notification after legal review.
legal-team: will review communications. please redact any full PII in logs prior to sharing. Provide recommended wording for acceptance.
rebecca-finance: for the postmortem, please include this table (provisional calc) in the doc — I'll use it to seed billing ticket: ```
Customer | FailedReq | UnitPrice | EstCostLoss | SLA% | EstCredit
nebula-ai | 1250 | $0.0004 | $0.50 | 10% | $0.05
papaya-ads | 420 | $0.0004 | $0.17 | 10% | $0.017
acme-corp | 3100 | $0.0004 | $1.24 | 25% | $0.31
```
rebecca-finance: note those numbers are placeholders — finance will replace with exact tokenized counts and per-customer pricing. Also need contract IDs and invoice refs.
liam-oc: ops note: added temporary `cache-regression-guard` alert that will trigger an on-call page if rollback/redeploy doesn't reduce 5xx within 8m.
sasha-pm: postmortem doc items checklist: timeline, root cause analysis, customer impact table, mitigation timeline, action items with owners, finance calc appendix, legal-approved customer message. I'll draft and circulate by EOD.
nina-support: exported request ids and linked them to customer accounts. added counts and sample traces; redacting PII per legal.
rebecca-finance: once postmortem is published, @rebecca-finance please — I'll open FIN-6427, attach the postmortem, and include provisional credit amounts. expected turnaround for provisional numbers: 48 business hours after postmortem.
deploy-bot: Notification: rollback to revision 23 completed at 1794604385 by liam-oc.
liam-oc: final ops handoff: system stable, muting noisy alerts for now. handing off to ana-sre for next 4 hours. leaving runbook notes in incident doc. :white_check_mark:
nana-sre: acknowledged. I'll run through follow-up checklist and postmortem notes. Adding link to GH issue #4123 for TTL guard and canary work.
sasha-pm: finance/pm alignment: after provisional credit calc, we'll prepare customer communication templates for three scenarios (minimal / probable / max) and include options for invoice-credit or account credit. legal signoff required for templates.
rebecca-finance: also confirm accounting code to post credits against (ACC-OPS-INCIDENT). I'll open the internal billing adjustment and tag invoices once we have concrete numbers.
legal-team: reviewed PM draft; minor wording edits recommended to avoid admission of systemic liability. will post redlines in doc.
rebecca-finance: one last procedural note: please include invoice numbers in the postmortem so we can attach credit memos to correct billing cycles and avoid double-crediting.
sasha-pm: publishing timeline: draft posted 1794610000, request review by 1794620000, final postmortem published 1794680721. Please action quick reviews so finance can move fast.
liam-oc: thanks all — good collaboration. closing thread when PM is published.
incident-bot: Incident resolved at 1794607890 — immediate mitigation: rollback. Postmortem scheduled.
